system.description:
Once per session, you can choose a foe as your Quarry—the focus of your hunt. You have a Quarry die, a special d6. When you or an ally attempts to research, locate, or attack your quarry, add your quarry die to the roll. If a quarry die rolls a '6', you can add a critical effect.

Survivalist: You take +1d when scouting, wrangling animals, placing traps, and on defense rolls against environmental hazards.

GROWTH: At levels 3 and 6, choose +1 Quarry per session.
